kit_page.name: cine_light_rig_kit
kit_page.summary: The cinematic light rig: KEY, FILL, back and BG lights, Easy looks, setups, flare and the live probe. The rim effect is on the Rim page.

kit_row.help: Overall light level in stops for the Easy look.
kit_row.label: Brightness

kit_row.help: Key-to-fill contrast in stops: 0 is flat, 2 natural, 5 noir.
kit_row.label: Drama

slider.name: cine_easy_drama
slider.tool_tip: KEY:FILL stop difference: 0 is flat, 2 is natural, and 5 is noir.

kit_row.help: Warms (+) or cools (-) all lights together, in mireds.
kit_row.label: Warmth

slider.name: cine_easy_warmth
slider.tool_tip: Relative colour-temperature trim in mireds: + warms and - cools all lights.

kit_row.help: Turns the back light on or off and sets its strength: Off, Faint, Subtle or Strong.
kit_row.label: Back light

kit_row.help: Turns the background light on or off and sets its strength: Off, Faint, Subtle or Strong.
kit_row.label: BG

kit_row.help: Sets all rig beams to narrow Snoot, medium Standard or wide Softbox.
kit_row.label: Cone

slider.name: cine_easy_cone_width
slider.tool_tip: Set all rig lights to a narrow Snoot, medium Standard, or wide Softbox beam.

kit_row.help: Softens or sharpens the visible edge of every light beam. Home: Atmosphere > Edge softness.
kit_row.label: Edge

slider.name: cine_easy_cone_feather
slider.tool_tip: Soften or sharpen the visible edge of every volumetric projector cone.

kit_row.help: Length in metres of the visible air beam; 0 follows each light's full range. Surface light is unchanged. Home: Atmosphere > Beam length.
kit_row.label: Vol. shaft

slider.name: cine_easy_shaft_length
slider.tool_tip: Volumetric shaft length in metres for every projector beam. 0 follows each projector's full light range; surface illumination is unchanged. Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 0.1 m steps.

kit_row.help: Applies a full lens-flare look. Master strength and intensity stay as they are.
kit_row.label: Flare

combo_box.name: cine_easy_flare_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Applies a full look (streak, ghosts, halo, rings, circles, iris, arc) and snaps back to this sentinel. Master strength/intensity are not touched by presets.

kit_row.help: Darkens everything outside a shape around the target subject, faking night.
kit_row.label: Night

kit_switch.name: cine_easy_night_mask_enable
kit_switch.tool_tip: Darkens everything outside a shape centred on the target subject, faking night.

kit_row.help: How much darker everything beyond the feather band gets: 0 none, 100 pitch black.
kit_row.label: Darkness

slider.name: cine_easy_night_mask_darkness
slider.tool_tip: How much darker everything beyond the feather band gets. 0% = no darkening, 100% = pitch black. Example: 89% leaves 11% of the light. Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 1% steps.

kit_row.help: Applies a full Night Mask look and snaps back to this entry.
kit_row.label: Preset

combo_box.name: cine_easy_night_mask_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Applies a full Night Mask look and snaps back to this sentinel.

kit_card.name: kc_easy_probe
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Capture a spherical environment-only PBR reflection probe around one rig. Cost depends on Live Probe > Refresh (Every frame = six cubemap views per frame).
kit_card.title: Easy probe

kit_row.help: Radius in metres of the spherical reflection probe around the rig.
kit_row.label: PBR radius

slider.name: cine_easy_probe_radius
slider.tool_tip: PBR reflection probe influence radius in metres (spherical). Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 0.25 m steps.

kit_row.help: Fill strength of the probe. Only values above the sky's own level change anything.
kit_row.label: Probe fill

slider.name: cine_easy_probe_ambiance
slider.tool_tip: Live probe ambiance (fill strength). Only values above the sky's own probe ambiance change anything; the Live Probe status shows the sky floor.

kit_row.help: How much of the rig's own bounce stays once the probe is live. 1 keeps all; 0 lets the probe replace it.
kit_row.label: Keep bounce

slider.name: cine_easy_probe_bounce_keep
slider.tool_tip: How much of the rig's own bounce/fill survives once the probe is live. 1 = keep all (probe only adds, never darkens). 0 = probe fully replaces it (old Replace bounce).

kit_row.help: Rig whose subject the live probe follows.
kit_row.label: Probe target

combo_box.name: cine_easy_probe_target
combo_box.tool_tip: Rig whose subject the live probe follows.

kit_row.help: Draws the probe's spherical influence boundary.
kit_row.label: Gizmo

kit_switch.name: cine_easy_probe_gizmo
kit_switch.tool_tip: Draw the live probe's spherical influence boundary.

kit_row.help: Distance from the subject in metres. Full brightness up to 9.1 m, dimming to nothing by 20 m.
kit_row.label: Radius

spinner.name: cine_radius
spinner.tool_tip: Orbit radius. Full brightness compensation up to 9.1 m; from 9.1–20 m the light dims as the 20 m projector reach cap bites; past 20 m the subject leaves the light's reach entirely. Scale-aware geometry grows with the subject, or grows with a spread anchor group, until the same cap.

kit_row.help: Vertical trim in metres from the anchor avatar's chest.

kit_row.help: Master exposure in stops, applied to every rig light.

kit_switch.tool_tip: Automatically cross-fade to a random master setup on an interval.

kit_row.help: Seconds between random setup changes while Random cycle is on.

slider.name: cine_random_interval
slider.tool_tip: Seconds between random setup changes.

kit_row.help: Curve for setup and aim transitions: Linear, Smoothstep, Ease-in-out or Ease-out.
kit_row.label: Easing

combo_box.name: cine_easing
combo_box.tool_tip: Transition curve used for setup loads, random cycling and live edits.

kit_row.help: Length of the transition in seconds for setup and aim changes.

kit_card.name: kc_live_probe
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Capture a spherical environment-only reflection probe around one rig. Cost depends on Live Probe > Refresh (Every frame = six cubemap views per frame).
kit_card.title: Live probe

kit_row.help: Rig whose subject centre the probe follows.
kit_row.label: Target

combo_box.name: cine_live_probe_target
combo_box.tool_tip: Rig whose smoothed subject centre the probe follows.

kit_row.help: Radius of the probe's influence in metres.
kit_row.label: Radius

spinner.name: cine_live_probe_radius
spinner.tool_tip: Spherical probe influence radius in metres.

kit_row.help: Fill strength of the probe. Values at or below the sky's own level do nothing.
kit_row.label: Ambiance

spinner.name: cine_live_probe_ambiance
spinner.tool_tip: Live probe ambiance (fill strength). Values at or below the sky's own probe ambiance have no effect; the status line below shows the sky floor.

kit_row.help: How much of the rig's own bounce survives once the probe is live. 1 keeps all.
kit_row.label: Keep bounce

spinner.name: cine_live_probe_bounce_keep
spinner.tool_tip: How much of the rig's own bounce/fill survives once the probe is live. 1 = keep all (probe only adds, never darkens). 0 = probe fully replaces it (old Replace bounce).

kit_row.help: How often the probe re-renders. Every frame is sharpest and costliest; On change stops once the scene matches.
kit_row.label: Refresh

combo_box.name: cine_live_probe_refresh
combo_box.tool_tip: How often the live probe re-renders its six cube faces. Every frame: full quality, highest cost. Balanced: 2 faces per frame (~1/3 cost). Economy: 1 face per frame (~1/6 cost); both lag and can seam with flickering lights. On change: refreshes at 2 faces per frame until the probe matches the scene, then stops (re-checks every 5 s); animated rig looks switch to Every frame. Manual: you choose how many faces to render and how many frames to wait between them (see Faces / Every below); no change detection, never idles, always refreshes at exactly that rate.

kit_row.help: Re-renders the probe once now. Used by On change and Manual.
kit_row.label: Refresh now

button.name: cine_live_probe_refresh_now
button.label: Refresh now
button.tool_tip: Re-render the live probe once now (On change and Manual modes; the other modes refresh continuously).

kit_row.help: Live probe state, including the sky's own probe floor.

kit_row.label: Height

spinner.name: cine_live_probe_offset
spinner.tool_tip: Vertical offset from the target rig centre.

kit_row.help: Manual refresh: cube faces rendered per refresh, 1 to 6.
kit_row.label: Faces

spinner.name: cine_live_probe_manual_faces
spinner.tool_tip: Manual refresh only. Cube faces rendered per refresh (1-6). A full probe update is two passes of six faces (irradiance, then radiance).

kit_row.help: Manual refresh: frames between refreshes, 1 to 120. 1 renders every frame.
kit_row.label: Every

spinner.name: cine_live_probe_manual_frames
spinner.tool_tip: Manual refresh only. Frames between refreshes (1-120). 1 = every frame; 4 = a quarter of the cost; 60 = about once a second at 60 fps.

kit_row.help: Unit label for the Every field.
